meta.title: RONB cross-reference — Baron's daily-transparent ETF as a BPTIX proxy
meta.what: RONB (Baron First Principles ETF) is run alongside BPTIX, holds SpaceX directly + the same public names, and publishes holdings DAILY -- so it's a high-frequency window on what Baron is doing, where BPTIX only files quarterly.
meta.caveat: Managed similarly, NOT identical: RONB is unlevered; pre-IPO they diverged (RONB took heavy subscriptions); RONB holds IBKR/MORN/ABNB/LYV that BPTIX's tracked set doesn't, and lacks BPTIX's CoStar (CSGP, a large BPTIX position). Use as a proxy + watchlist, not a copy.

implied_bptix.note: RONB prints its close the same day, before BPTIX's NAV posts. RONB's daily return x the post-IPO beta (1.31) is a leading estimate of BPTIX's move.

spacex_check.note: RONB carries SpaceX at 32.0% of net (ETF, unlevered, direct shares). BPTIX's back-solved SpaceX weight is ~37% -- higher because BPTIX is/was levered and sized SpaceX larger. The two move together; RONB is the independent floor/triangulation.

holdings.name: Red Rock Resorts Inc Class A

compare.ronb_only_note: In RONB, not in BPTIX's tracked 5/31 set -> candidate new names BPTIX may already hold or add.
compare.bptix_only_note: In BPTIX (5/31), not in RONB -> BPTIX-specific (notably CoStar/CSGP); RONB can't proxy these.
